signal: EliseAI raised a $250M Series E at a $2.2B valuation in 2025, crossed $100M ARR, and is tripling headcount past 300

email.body1:
Jason, saw EliseAI closed its $250M Series E at a $2.2B valuation, crossed $100M ARR, and is tripling the team past 300.

Scaling that fast usually means more accounts in play than the team can cover before the new reps ramp, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for EliseAI off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Jason, quick follow-up for EliseAI.

Post-raise, board expectations on pipeline usually jump faster than even aggressive hiring can ramp. Most teams do not actually know how many meetings they need to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter turns into a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings EliseAI needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Jason, last bit of proof for EliseAI.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how EliseAI's reply rate likely compares to other late-stage AI startups. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
Jason, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Timing is everything right after a raise, and tripling a team is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a high-growth motion? I will tailor it to EliseAI either way.
